remarks: A rare opportunity to enjoy the 2 Bedroom 2 Bathroom Penthouse in Harbor House - the luxury waterfront community in coveted Shippan. Enjoy stunning views of the city, the harbor, and breathtaking sunsets. The main level open-concept layout seamlessly blends the Kitchen, Dining, and Living areas adorned with exquisite custom millwork. Gourmet Kitchen with custom cabinetry and high-end appliances including sub-zero fridge, Living Room with vaulted ceilings, wood-burning fireplace and floor-to-ceiling bookcase create unmatched character, while sliders to the private Balcony bathe the space in natural light and provide access to the outdoor relaxation. The main level also features a large entryway and hallway with ample storage, a spacious Bedroom and Full Bath, Laundry Closet with brand new washer/dryer and a separate Walk-In Pantry. Upper level provides a luxurious escape - Primary Bedroom with skylights and 2 closets with custom built-ins, and a spa-like Primary Bathroom with custom double-sink vanity and oversize tub for ultimate relaxation. The complex offers separate entrances and elevators shared by 2 units per floor, covered garage (1 assigned space), plenty of additional secure parking, and beautifully maintained grounds. Just minutes to parks and beaches, I-95, Metro-North (under an hour train ride to NYC), and the vibrant life of downtown Stamford. Excellent credit and proof of income required. No smokers.
